scope: Identical public weather, ocean and aircraft providers, HUD layout, backend, configuration, save/migration, equipment and account synchronization owners. The only runtime differences are the twelve reviewed transient visual/scene files. Actual packaged upgrade/fallback/write/return is required.

app/js/engine/building-facade-materials..review: Facade shading and parallax uniforms only; no persistent world or player state.

app/js/engine/night-lighting.js.review: Transient window emission and bounded light intensity under existing lighting owner; no saved settings format changes.

app/js/engine/procedural-textures.js.review: Generated pavement/asphalt material texture bytes only; no persistence or network protocol.

app/js/world/building-batching.js.review: Per-instance facade attributes and rendering only; unchanged source building identity.

app/js/world/building-exterior-details.j.review: Transient facade trim and awning geometry under existing disposal owner; no durable records.

app/js/world/building-facade-layout.js.review: Pure facade layout and near/mid rendering profile; no save or provider format changes.

app/js/world/facade-lighting.js.review: New shared transient shader uniform; no persistent or protocol owner.

app/js/world/reference-block-dressing.js.review: Authored ephemeral street furniture placement, collision and lamp registration; never writes player/world saves.

app/js/world/storefront-layout.js.review: Storefront sign height in transient facade geometry only; shop and equipment models unchanged.

app/js/world/storefront-signs.js.review: Sign mesh placement only; no business identity or persistent changes.

app/js/world/street-pavement-runtime.js.review: Pavement material detail and lifecycle-managed authored furniture; terrain/save/protocol owners unchanged.

app/js/world/vegetation.js.review: Existing placement pipeline accepts authored planter trees; transient placement and collision clearance only.
